name: Armored Clothing
desc: A bulletproof vest worn under a buttoned-up shirt, a kevlar-reinforced christmas sweater, or a very thick synth-leather jacket are all equally terrible at protecting you in a real gunfight, but they might be able to stop the occasional stray bullet down the block. Most city-dwellers wear these as everyday wear.

name: Armored Vest
desc: Corporate police forces and battle-ready street scum wear these thick kevlar vests in an attempt to keep alive in the mean streets of the Sixth World.

name: Armored Jacket
special: Determining that the jacket is armored required an Average ([[dd]]) Perception skill check

name: Multifunctional Workwear
special: Counts as toolkit and utility belt

name: Chameleon Suit
special: As a maneuver, add [[bb]] to Stealth skill checks

name: Survival Suit
special: Remove [[s]] from all checks imposed by chosen hostile environment

name: Hazardous Environment Suit
special: Gain Resilience 2 (or add one rank) when resisting the prolonged effects of hostile environments, and add [[s]] to all Reflexes, Perception and Vigilance skill checks

name: Diving Suit
special: Can be sealed, holds air for 8 hours
